name: Amuse-bouche

name: From the Coast
ingredients: Line-caught seer fish cured in kokum, coconut milk, curry-leaf oil, puffed red rice.

name: A Pause
ingredients: Kashmiri green tea, saffron, cardamom, almond snow.

name: The South

name: Dessert
